title: review-run cancel --json
description: The run after cancel (state failed, reason canceled, exit_code 143), unchanged for a terminal run, a run finalized by the refresh or a dry run, or still running with cancel_requested_at set when this command could not end it: a live runner or launcher after 120 s, a run lease still held by another process after 120 s, or an agent still live after this command's successful stop.

changed.description: false for a run that was already terminal or ended by the refresh, a run in phase finalize, a dry run, and a repeat invocation that only signals or waits and leaves the runner alive; true when this invocation recorded the cancellation or ended the run.

action.description: none (terminal, or nothing to act on), stop (agent-spawn stop of an agent that is not parked), signal_runner (SIGTERM to the verified live runner when no agent exists) or signal_launcher (SIGTERM to the verified live agent-spawn launcher when no agent id and no runner exist; while the launcher's PID or start is not stored no signal is sent and the command only waits out the window). teardown is reserved and not emitted by review-run today.

warnings.description: The run's own warnings after the command (any code of the run warning list).
